events.verdict: Quickley (TOR) initiates illegal contact to Watson (DEN) as he pursues the loose ball.
Jones (DEN) and Barnes (TOR) briefly engage and disengage as they pursue the rebound.
Murray-Boyles (TOR) maintains a legal guarding position alongside Hardaway Jr.'s (DEN) path as he defends the shot attempt. Barrett (TOR) reaches in and avoids making contact to Hardaway Jr.'s arm.
Hardaway Jr. (DEN) is not established in a legal guarding position in Quickley's (TOR) path at the time of the contact.
Holmes II (DEN) loses his balance after coming together with his teammate Watson (DEN). Any contact with Murray-Boyles (TOR) is incidental.
Holmes II (DEN) extends his lower body into Barnes' (TOR) path and initiates illegal contact.
Watson (DEN) legally contests Ingram's (TOR) jump shot attempt.
Murray-Boyles (TOR) maintains verticality and absorbs the contact initiated by Watson (DEN) during his dunk attempt.
Murray (DEN) legally recovers the loose ball in the backcourt.
Jones (DEN) initiates illegal contact to Quickley (TOR) that causes him to lose his balance during the loose ball.
Walter (TOR) commits a take foul on Jones (DEN).
Jones (DEN) maintains a legal guarding position during Ingram's (TOR) drive to the basket and dunk attempt.
Murray (DEN) disengages with Shead (TOR) without extending into him prior to receiving the pass.
Quickley (TOR) commits a take foul on Brown (DEN).

After communicating with the Replay Center, it is determined that Ingram (TOR) does not release the shot attempt prior to the expiration of the game clock. The on-court ruling is overturned to no basket.
